item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.descr: Grants Viltrumite strength and durability, plus self-propelled flight while carried.
item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.fligh: G toggles flight. [ and ] select hover, cruise, or full speed. Forward and backward follow your full look angle, including pitch; jump and sneak add vertical thrust. The Superman glide pose engages only after reaching flight speed. Keys are configurable in Controls.
